items.title: Marikina marks National Bike Day 2026 with community ride
items.excerpt: Cyclists in Marikina City took to the city's dedicated bike lanes for a community ride in celebration of National Bike Day 2026.
items.author: Gab Ocampo

items.title: Tajonera House lights up for Christmas in Marikina
items.excerpt: Marikina City Mayor Maan Teodoro and Congressman Marcy Teodoro joined the lighting ceremony of Tajonera House along Sinai Street in Barangay Concepcion Dos, marking the return of its festive Christmas display.
items.author: Mariel Guevarra

items.excerpt: Marikina City Mayor Maan Teodoro and Congressman Marcy Teodoro welcomed representatives from the Municipality of Sablayan, Occidental Mindoro, for a benchmarking visit aimed at strengthening cooperation between the two…
items.author: Gab Ocampo

items.title: Marikina opens Christmas Shoe Bazaar 2026
items.excerpt: Marikina Mayor Maan Teodoro and Congressman Marcy Teodoro formally opened the Marikina Christmas Shoe Bazaar 2026, featuring locally made footwear, bags, and other leather products.
items.author: Gab Ocampo

items.title: Marikina welcomes ASEAN delegates for 2026 Summit
items.excerpt: The Marikina City Government, led by Mayor Maan Teodoro, welcomed ASEAN ministers and delegates from different Southeast Asian countries during the 36th ASEAN Socio-Cultural Community Meeting as part of the ASEAN 2026…
items.author: MAJCC

items.title: Marikina bags 6 trophies at 2026 SubayBAYANI Awards
items.excerpt: The Marikina City Government received six awards at the 2026 Regional SubayBAYANI Awards of the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG), held on October 29, 2026, at Marco Polo Ortigas in Pasig City.
items.author: Gabrielle Javier

items.title: Marikina approves year-end bonuses and incentives for workers
items.excerpt: The Marikina City Government has approved year-end bonuses for its employees and other personnel serving the city as part of its Christmas benefits program.
items.author: Gab Ocampo

items.title: Maan Teodoro continues outreach visits to Marikina homeowners associations
items.excerpt: Marikina Mayor Maan Teodoro continued her visits to homeowners associations (HOAs) across the city to personally meet residents and strengthen coordination with local communities.
items.author: Mike Solomon

items.title: Marikina installs 44 new streetlights along Concepcion Dos bike lane
items.excerpt: The Marikina City Government has opened 44 newly installed streetlights along the bike lane in Barangay Concepcion Dos to provide better lighting and improve safety for cyclists, particularly at night.
items.author: Sinagtala

items.title: Marikina holds successful Tara, Trabaho G! Job Fair 2026
items.excerpt: The Marikina City Government successfully held the Tara, Trabaho G! Job Fair 2026, providing job seekers with opportunities to explore employment openings from various companies.
items.author: Sinagtala

items.title: Marikina opens new Tech-Voc building at Malanday National High School
items.excerpt: The new Technical-Vocational (Tech-Voc) Building at Malanday National High School has been formally opened and inaugurated, providing additional classrooms and facilities for students.
items.author: Malaya

items.title: Marikina to open Christmas Shoe Bazaar on Nov. 13
items.excerpt: The Marikina City Government is set to reopen the Marikina Christmas Shoe Bazaar 2026, continuing a local tradition that showcases the craftsmanship and creativity of the city's shoemakers.
items.author: Carlo Cameron

items.title: Marikina expands CCTV network along Gil Fernando Avenue
items.excerpt: The Marikina City Government is installing additional closed-circuit television (CCTV) cameras along Gil Fernando Avenue as part of its ongoing efforts to expand the city's surveillance network.
items.author: Ryan Chua

items.title: Marikina Coffee Fest 2026 opens
items.excerpt: The Marikina Coffee Fest 2026 officially opened at Marikina Freedom Park, welcoming coffee enthusiasts and visitors to explore a variety of locally produced coffee offerings.
items.author: Mike Solomon

items.title: Marikina announces road rerouting for Coffee Festival
items.excerpt: The Marikina City Government announced temporary road closures around Marikina Freedom Park from November 6 to 8, 2026, in preparation for the Marikina Coffee Festival 2026.
